description: Scrub sensitive text or JSON in RAM using NIST SP 800-38G Rev. 1 FF1 format-preserving synthetic twins (ISO/IEC 7812 Luhn PANs, ISO-7064 MOD-97 IBANs, RFC 2606 emails, quantized 60s timestamps and monetary bands) with ephemeral CSPRNG keys.

payload.description: JSON object, array, or string to pseudonymize.

name: sip_pseudonymize_payload
title: NIST SP 800-38G FF1 Payload Pseudonymizer
